Dismantle the cooling water, lubricating oil and sealing water pipes and the 
 claw coupling guard.

Dismantle the claw coupling spacer, check the alignment of the coupling and 
 record it.

Dismantle the thrust bearing cap, remove the nuts, the thrust bearing discs 
 and the thrust bearing housing top figure 3.

Screw the suspension bolts into the threads in the thrust bearing shell and 
 pull the complete shell together with the thrust bearing disk off the shaft ( 
 raise slightly ) by means of a lifting tackle.
Disassemble the thrust bearing shell completely.
Remove the upper half of the radial bearing shell figure 3.

By means of a lever ( wooden or steel bar with a protective soft sleeve ) 
 slightly raise the pump shaft, remove the lower half of the
 Radial bearing shell and check whether.

sections.text: Dismantling of Hydraulic Part of Pump
Dismount the pump from the bedplate and place it on erection pads figure (2).

Remove the thrust bearing including bearing housing, mechanical seal on the 
 discharge side and the seal cage and the balance device

Remove the radial bearing and the mechanical seal on the suction side ( 
 without dismantling the seal cage on the suction side ).
أعد تجميع المحمل الشعاعي على جانب الشفط.
Remove the pump cover and the thermal insulation.
Place screw jacks under the last but one and the last stage ring sections.
Remove the stator connection bolts.
Remove the discharge casing.
Remove the last stage impeller in the following way figure (1).
Move the rotor of the extreme position toward the discharge.

تحقق مما إذا كان تم وضع علامة على موضع المكره بالنسبة إلى العمود 
 أو وضع علامة على هذا الموقف. قم بتغطية جزء من العمود خلف محور المكره 
 نسيج الأسبستوس. قم بتركيب رافعتين بين قرص المكره الأمامي و 
 قسم حلقة المرحلة. يجب أن تتحمل الرافعات المكره في الشاحنات. بواسطة 
 تمارس وسائل الرافعة ضغطًا طفيفًا على المكره وفي نفس الوقت 
 قم بتسخين محور المكره بسرعة وبشكل موحد إما عن طريق الحلقي 
 موقد غاز لشعلة مجموعة لحام أوكسي الأسيتيلين.

After heating up to a temperature of approx. 180 C, when due to thermal 
 expansion, the impeller hub is loose on the shaft, remove the protective 
 asbestos fabric and pull the impeller off the shaft.

Transfer the screw jack supporting the last stage section so that when the 
 last stage section is dismantled it will support the two end stage sections on 
 the discharge side.

Dismantle the last stage section including the diffuser and the thrust ring of 
 the last stage impeller.

قم بإزالة الدفاعات الأخرى (باستثناء دفاعة المرحلة الأولى) والمرحلة 
 الإجراء هو نفسه بالنسبة لتفكيك المرحلة الأخيرة 
 القسم والمكره.

When dismantling the fourth stage section and impeller and the impellers of 
 the other stages, it is necessary to support the shaft by means of a screw 
 jack to prevent the pump from turning over .
Remove the radial bearing on the suction side.
Remove the shaft together with the first stage impeller.
Remove the seal cage on the suction side.
Remove the first stage impeller from the shaft.

Remove the first stage diffuser and the other diffusers up to the last but one 
 stage diffuser.

Remove the sealing rings of diffusers, stage sections and of the suction 
 casing.

sections.text: حَشد
Assembly of Hydraulic Part of Pump

Mount the diffuser, stage section and suction casing sealing rings, before 
 mounting the sealing rings should be chilled .
Secure the sealing rings by adjusting screws M 8 x 10.
Fit the diffusers on the walls.
Fix the suction casing on an erection pad.
Mount the first stage impeller on the shaft figure (7).
Fit the impeller keys in the keyway in the shaft.

Place the impeller on a fire clay block and warm up the impeller hub to a 
 temperature of 180 C by means of an annular burner.

Fit the impeller on the shaft, drive it to the shaft shoulder and turn it to 
 the right .
Cover the impeller hub all around quickly with asbestos fabric.

Hold the impeller pressed to the shaft shoulder for a period of approximately 
 one minute.
Remove the asbestos fabric from the impeller shaft.
Mount the suction mechanical seal seat on the shaft.
Mount the suction seal cage.

قم بتركيب النصف السفلي من المحمل الشعاعي على طرف الشفط في قفص الختم. 
 قبل تشديد صواميل البراغي التي يتم من خلالها تثبيت مبيت المحمل بشكل كامل 
 تعلق على قفص الختم، وختم القفص بواسطة دبابيس تفتق.

Fit the pump shaft with the first stage impeller mounted on it into the 
 suction casing. Support the shaft in the bearing journal on the discharge side 
 by means of a jack.
Assemble the radial bearing shells and housing.

Carry out a check adjustment of the rotor ( axial and radial ) so that the 
 suction casing face wall is adjusted to the impeller passage inner wall ( 
 suction end ) figure ( 6 ).

Measure the distance between the shaft end and the face wall of the radial 
 bearing housing ( the measured value must be recorded ) .

Move the rotor to the extreme position toward the suction and measure again 
 the distance between the shaft end and the face wall of the radial bearing 
 housing, ( the measured value must be recorded ) measurement of the 
 clearance to the suction .
Mount the first stage ring section.

Move the rotor to the extreme position toward the discharge and measure the 
 distance between the shaft end and the face wall of the radial bearing 
 housing.

With type 150-CHM pumps, the minimum clearance to the discharge is for the 
 first stage and up to the last but one stage impeller 3.2 mm, for the last 
 stage impeller 5.2 mm.

Place the impeller split thrust ring in the recess in the shaft behind the 
 first stage impeller hub.
Mount the impeller and the second stage to the last.
Mount the discharge casing.

The axial clearance and the basic adjustment of impellers must be measured at 
 all the stages .
Fit the connection bolts.
Carry out the complete assembly of the entire pump.

sections.text: Assembly of Bearings, Mechanical Seals and Balance Device
تجميع الوحدات الوظيفية المذكورة أعلاه عندما تكون مكونة من وحدات جديدة.
The following rules should be observed.

When the balance device is replaced by a new one, the alignment of the rotor 
 should be checked figure (8).

When mechanical seals and thrust bearing are replaced by new ones, the 
 adjustment of the balance must be checked figure (4).

Radial bearings can be replaced independently of the baince device, seals and 
 thrust bearing, provided however , that they are not damaged to such an extent 
 that will render the alignment of the rotor impossible. Whenever the radial 
 bearing are replaced, the alignment of the rotor with regard to the stator 
 must be checked figure ( 3 ).

If both radial bearings are to be replaced, replace first the radial bearing 
 on the suction side.

sections.text: Assembly of Radial Bearings

Grind in the spherical surface of the shell of the radial bearing on the 
 suction side with the bearing body fixed in a vice or on an assembly bench.

Then the bearing housing and the lower bearing shell must be screwed together 
 and dowelled.

Into the lower bearing housing make sure the oil groove is on the side of 
 both oil inlets in the bearing housing.

Then the lower and the upper bearing housing halves must be screwed together 
 and dowelled.

Fix the lever for grinding in on the radial bearing shell and check wether the 
 shell is an interference fit in the bearing housing. If the shell is loose in 
 the bearing housing, it is necessary to grind or scrape the dividing plane ( 
 in the upper or lower housing ) so that the shell is fitted in the bearing 
 housing with a small interference .

For grinding in, coat the spherical surface with fine grinding paste and 
 grind in with a swinging movement of the grinding lever ( the upper and the 
 lower bearing housing parts being slightly tightened by connection bolts ). 
 Proceed in this way until approx. 70% of the spherical surface is ground in ( 
 matte surface ).

Remove the bearing shell from the bearing housing, remove grinding paste and 
 clean, provide with a preservative coating.

Assemble the shell with bearing housing and check whether, after the bolts 
 have been tightened and the upper and lower bearing housing halves have been 
 dowelled, the shell can be removed.
For the radial bearing on the discharge side the procedure is the same.

sections.text: Assembly of Balance Device

Before fitting the balance device, the radial bearing on the suction side 
 must be completely assembled .
Remove the bearing housing on the discharge side including the seal cage.

Fit the bearing plate together with o-rings into the discharge casing ( fit by 
 slight tapping on the plates )

Align the rotor axially with regard to the stator i.e. adjust the shaft 
 end on the suction side toward the bearing housing so that distance between 
 them is equal to the value stamped on the bearing housing . secure the rotor 
 in its position with regard to the stator.

Measure the distance between the bearing plate face and the shaft shoulder 1 
 and the ring width s ( see figure (8) 
 measure the values a and b on the balance disk and adjust the 
 spacer ring by grinding to the value x with tolerance 0.05

sections.text: Assembly of Mechanical Seals

Adjust the pump rotor its extreme position toward suction ( the balance disk 
 is pressed against the bearing plate ).

Clean thoroughly and coat with oil the cylindrical part of the flange of the 
 mechanical seal on the discharge end, fitted, and the mechanical seal . fit 
 . the seal on the flange and adjust the seal ( when the balance disk bears 
 against the plate, the mechanical seal springs are compressed by 3.5 mm ) 
 secure the seal in its adjusted position by means of adjusting screws.

Place the O ring in the recess in the seal cage and screw up the seal 
 flange together with the mechanical seal to the seal cage.

The procedure for the assembly of the mechanical seal on the suction end is 
 the same.

sections.text: Assembly of Thrust Bearing to Feed Water Pump

Fit the front bearing shoes including guide shoes and bearing rings into the 
 thrust bearing cage.
Mount the rear thrust shoes and the bearing on the thrust bearing cage cover.

Coat the thrust disk faces with paint and assemble completely the thrust 
 bearing cage with the bearing disk and thrust bearing cage cover.
Remove the thrust bearing cover and disk.

Check the contact of the thrust shoe with the bearing disk and scrape, if 
 necessary.

Reassemble the thrust bearing cage, cover and disk measure the axial 
 clearance of the thrust bearing disk in the bearing (the correct clearance is 
 0.25 to 0.4mm)
Check the preload of the disk spring of the thrust bearing .

Check the grinding in of the thrust bearing ring, the bearing thrust disk and 
 the thrust bearing cage ( check with paint ) .

Adjust the pump rotor into the extreme position toward the suction ( balance 
 disk bears against the plate ) secure the rotor in this position.

Measure the length of the shaft end ( dia. 55 mm including thread M ssx2 ) 
 from the radial bearing journal face L1.
قم بقياس الطول الإجمالي لمحور القرص الذي يحمل الدفع L1.
Assemble the bearing spacing plate, the thrust ring without the disk spring.
Determine the thrust bearing spacing ring width.
Adjust the thrust bearing spacing ring width to x1 .

Measure and / or adjust the axial clearance between the thrust bearing cage 
 cover and housing cover .
Dismantle the cage including the thrust bearing disk .

Assemble the thrust bearing completely . secure the thrust bearing spacing 
 plate and thrust ring in their positions by the adjusting screws on the 
 bearing housing .
Starting of Pump

Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Check the quantity of oil in the thrust-bearing sump.
Open the inlet for cooling the oil bath of the thrust bearing.
Check whether the inlet for flooding the stuffing box is open.
Check whether the inlet for hydraulic sealing of the suspension is open.
Check whether the delivery sluice valve is closed.

Mount the diffuser, stage section and suction casing sealing rings, before

تجميع الوحدات الوظيفية المذكورة أعلاه عندما تكون مكونة من وحدات جديدة.
The following rules should be observed.
When the balance device is replaced by a new one, the alignment of the rotor 
 should be checked figure (8).
When mechanical seals and thrust bearing are replaced by new ones, the 
 adjustment of the balance must be checked figure (4).
Radial bearings can be replaced independently of the baince device, seals and 
 thrust bearing, provided however , that they are not damaged to such an extent 
 that will render the alignment of the rotor impossible. Whenever the radial 
 bearing are replaced, the alignment of the rotor with regard to the stator 
 must be checked figure ( 3 ).
If both radial bearings are to be replaced, replace first the radial bearing 
 on the suction side.
تجميع الوحدات الوظيفية المذكورة أعلاه عندما تكون مكونة من وحدات جديدة.
The following rules should be observed.
When the balance device is replaced by a new one, the alignment of the rotor 
 should be checked figure (8).
When mechanical seals and thrust bearing are replaced by new ones, the 
 adjustment of the balance must be checked figure (4).
Radial bearings can be replaced independently of the baince device, seals and 
 thrust bearing, provided however , that they are not damaged to such an extent

 bearing are replaced, the alignment of the rotor with regard to the stator

If both radial bearings are to be replaced, replace first the radial bearing

Assembly of Radial Bearings
Grind in the spherical surface of the shell of the radial bearing on the 
 suction side with the bearing body fixed in a vice or on an assembly bench.
Then the bearing housing and the lower bearing shell must be screwed together 
 and dowelled.
Into the lower bearing housing make sure the oil groove is on the side of 
 both oil inlets in the bearing housing.
Then the lower and the upper bearing housing halves must be screwed together 
 and dowelled.
Fix the lever for grinding in on the radial bearing shell and check wether the 
 shell is an interference fit in the bearing housing. If the shell is loose in 
 the bearing housing, it is necessary to grind or scrape the dividing plane ( 
 in the upper or lower housing ) so that the shell is fitted in the bearing 
 housing with a small interference .
For grinding in, coat the spherical surface with fine grinding paste and 
 grind in with a swinging movement of the grinding lever ( the upper and the 
 lower bearing housing parts being slightly tightened by connection bolts ). 
 Proceed in this way until approx. 70% of the spherical surface is ground in ( 
 matte surface ).
Remove the bearing shell from the bearing housing, remove grinding paste and 
 clean, provide with a preservative coating.
Assemble the shell with bearing housing and check whether, after the bolts 
 have been tightened and the upper and lower bearing housing halves have been 
 dowelled, the shell can be removed.
For the radial bearing on the discharge side the procedure is the same.
Grind in the spherical surface of the shell of the radial bearing on the 
 suction side with the bearing body fixed in a vice or on an assembly bench.
Then the bearing housing and the lower bearing shell must be screwed together 
 and dowelled.
Into the lower bearing housing make sure the oil groove is on the side of 
 both oil inlets in the bearing housing.
Then the lower and the upper bearing housing halves must be screwed together 
 and dowelled.

 shell is an interference fit in the bearing housing. If the shell is loose in 
 the bearing housing, it is necessary to grind or scrape the dividing plane ( 
 in the upper or lower housing ) so that the shell is fitted in the bearing 
 housing with a small interference .
For grinding in, coat the spherical surface with fine grinding paste and 
 grind in with a swinging movement of the grinding lever ( the upper and the 
 lower bearing housing parts being slightly tightened by connection bolts ). 
 Proceed in this way until approx. 70% of the spherical surface is ground in ( 
 matte surface ).
Remove the bearing shell from the bearing housing, remove grinding paste and 
 clean, provide with a preservative coating.
Assemble the shell with bearing housing and check whether, after the bolts 
 have been tightened and the upper and lower bearing housing halves have been 
 dowelled, the shell can be removed.
For the radial bearing on the discharge side the procedure is the same.

Before fitting the balance device, the radial bearing on the suction side

Fit the bearing plate together with o-rings into the discharge casing ( fit by

Align the rotor axially with regard to the stator i.e. adjust the shaft

Assembly of Mechanical Seals
Adjust the pump rotor its extreme position toward suction ( the balance disk

Clean thoroughly and coat with oil the cylindrical part of the flange of the

Assembly of Thrust Bearing to Feed Water Pump
Fit the front bearing shoes including guide shoes and bearing rings into the 
 thrust bearing cage.
Mount the rear thrust shoes and the bearing on the thrust bearing cage cover.
Coat the thrust disk faces with paint and assemble completely the thrust 
 bearing cage with the bearing disk and thrust bearing cage cover.
Remove the thrust bearing cover and disk.
Check the contact of the thrust shoe with the bearing disk and scrape, if 
 necessary.
Reassemble the thrust bearing cage, cover and disk measure the axial 
 clearance of the thrust bearing disk in the bearing (the correct clearance is 
 0.25 to 0.4mm)
Check the preload of the disk spring of the thrust bearing .
Check the grinding in of the thrust bearing ring, the bearing thrust disk and 
 the thrust bearing cage ( check with paint ) .
Adjust the pump rotor into the extreme position toward the suction ( balance 
 disk bears against the plate ) secure the rotor in this position.
Measure the length of the shaft end ( dia. 55 mm including thread M ssx2 ) 
 from the radial bearing journal face L1.
قم بقياس الطول الإجمالي لمحور القرص الذي يحمل الدفع L1.

Determine the thrust bearing spacing ring width.
Adjust the thrust bearing spacing ring width to x1 .
Measure and / or adjust the axial clearance between the thrust bearing cage 
 cover and housing cover .
Dismantle the cage including the thrust bearing disk .
Assemble the thrust bearing completely . secure the thrust bearing spacing

 bearing housing .
Starting of Pump
Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Check the quantity of oil in the thrust-bearing sump.
Open the inlet for cooling the oil bath of the thrust bearing.
Check whether the inlet for flooding the stuffing box is open.
